blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Quezon City Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas on Tuesday filed a landmark bill that seeks to incentivize recycling of household waste. Vargas said that House Bill No. 11146, or the Basura to Ayuda Act, aims to allow individuals, households, homeowners associations, and civic organizations to exchange their collected non-hazardous recyclable materials for cash aid or essential goods. “Through this bill, we hit two birds with one stone. Pinapalakas natin ang kultura ng recycling at pangangalaga sa kalikasan, habang binibigyan natin ang ating mga kababayan ng pagkakataon na kumita mula sa kanilang mga basura,” Vargas said in a statement.
